Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.EncounterMinDay: Game days a player has to be online before the next wanderer group is sent to them. Players close to each other share one group.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.EncounterMaxDay: The wait is picked between minimum and maximum. The defaults give about 0.4 groups per player per day.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.AreaDistance_to: In tiles. Players this close to each other, also through other players, share their wanderer groups.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.KeepAwayDistanc: In tiles. Wanderer groups that were not sent to a player are moved away when they get this close to one.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.FarPoints_toolt: Destinations around each player where wanderer groups start and roam.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.FarMinDistance_: In tiles, at least 100 more than the keep away distance.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.FarMaxDistance_: In tiles. Groups move about 4 tiles per game minute.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.RecycleDistance: In tiles. Wanderer groups farther than this from every player are moved to a far point around a player.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.RegularSpawnCha: In percent of each clan's spawn chance, for assault groups, defenders, camps, roadblocks and companions, not wanderers. Group sizes stay the same. 40 gives about 0.45 groups per day from day 30 on, about 0.2 to 0.3 before.
